body.message:
Yes, certainly. The process is as follows:

- First, you will need to complete the security deposit payment.
- Once the deposit payment is received, we can proceed with blocking the unit for you.
- The remaining rental payment can then be completed before your check-in date.

If you wish to make the rental payment through the payment link, please note that a 3.1% card processing fee will apply. Alternatively, you may also proceed with a bank transfer, which will not incur the card processing fee.

Please note that the unit can only be blocked once the security deposit has been successfully received
